propositions: Bridge provider heldout matrix test fails on macOS dev hosts when agent harnesses export command-scope git config (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit) via environment, but passes in CI which lacks these exports.
The git()/bare_git() harness helpers in test_run_reconcile_bridge.py inherit os.environ wholesale, causing safe.bareRepository=explicit to block bare repository access in verification git calls.
Unsetting only GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_* environment variables flips all 5 matrix parameters from FAIL to PASS on affected dev hosts, confirming root cause.
The same ambient git config injection breaks 21 tests across test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py on hostile hosts.
Harness fix must scrub command-scope git-config injection vars and pin GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null + GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 in git helpers and runner_env() to hold out ambient host config.

Matrix test must unconditionally monkeypatch the hostile injection (GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit) to make the regression deterministic in CI while preserving the gh-independence hold-out.
